command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, re
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_parquet('/app/merged_users.parquet')
print("columns:", list(df.columns))
print("dtypes:\n", df.dtypes)
print(df.to_string())

assert list(df.columns) == ["user_id","name","email","created_date","status"], "column order/schema"
assert pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(df["user_id"]), "user_id must be integer"
assert df["user_id"].is_unique, "user_id must be unique"
assert sorted(df["user_id"].tolist()) == [101,102,103,104], "all unique users present"
pat = re.compile(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$")
assert all(pat.match(str(v)) for v in df["created_date"]), "date format"
assert all(pd.Timestamp(str(v)) for v in df["created_date"])

rep = json.load(open('/app/conflicts.json'))
assert set(rep.keys()) == {"total_conflicts","conflicts"}, rep.keys()
assert rep["total_conflicts"] == len(rep["conflicts"]), "count mismatch"
for c in rep["conflicts"]:
    assert set(c.keys()) == {"user_id","field","values","selected"}, c.keys()
    assert isinstance(c["user_id"], int)
    assert c["field"] in {"name","email","created_date","status"}
    assert len(set(c["values"].values())) > 1, "conflict with identical values"
    order = [s for s in ["source_a","source_b","source_c"] if s in c["values"]]
    assert c["selected"] == c["values"][order[0]], "selected not highest priority"
    assert c["user_id"] in df["user_id"].tolist()

# cross-check merged values equal selected / highest-priority source values
for _, r in df.iterrows():
    for f in ["name","email","created_date","status"]:
        rel = [c for c in rep["conflicts"] if c["user_id"] == r["user_id"] and c["field"] == f]
        if rel:
            assert rel[0]["selected"] == r[f], (r["user_id"], f)

print("\nOK total_conflicts =", rep["total_conflicts"])
print("ALL SANITY CHECKS PASSED")
EOF
